name: OSCAL

source_set.identifier: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5.2.0 Privacy Baseline Profile

allowed_use_boundary: Use machine-readable control, implementation, assessment, and remediation artifacts as structured evidence only.
Preserve OSCAL-native model terminology and distinguish OSCAL model/release version from individual document/content version.
Use schema-validity and reference-resolution results as evidence properties, not as proof that represented controls are implemented, effective, current, or authorized.
Do not treat OSCAL inclusion as certification, endorsement, standing, execution authority, or commit-time authority.
claims: OSCAL 1.2.2 provides machine-readable models for catalogs, profiles, component definitions, system security plans, assessment plans, assessment results, plans of action and milestones, and control mappings.
OSCAL artifacts can provide structured control and assessment evidence for reconstruction and review.
A pinned public OSCAL 1.2.2 profile sample demonstrates distinct document-version and oscal-version metadata in an official NIST content release.
non_claims: OSCAL does not prove transition admissibility.
Machine readability or schema validity does not create authority.
A valid OSCAL document does not prove represented controls are implemented, effective, fresh, or applicable to the transition.
The StegVerse compatibility fixture is a bounded mapping test and is not NIST certification or endorsement.

transition_table_mapping.allowed_use_boundary: machine-readable control and assessment evidence only
transition_table_mapping.claims: catalog, profile, component-definition, SSP, assessment-plan, assessment-results, POA&M, control-mapping, and structured evidence representation
transition_table_mapping.non_claims: no admissibility proof, certification, endorsement, standing, or execution authority
transition_table_mapping.input_artifact_type: versioned OSCAL control, implementation, assessment, remediation, or mapping document
transition_table_mapping.actor_or_authority_model: OSCAL party/responsibility records are evidence declarations; current StegVerse authority is independently reconstructed
transition_table_mapping.evidence_model: versioned machine-readable models plus references, hashes, validation state, and assessment freshness
transition_table_mapping.policy_or_rule_model: catalogs and profiles may supply structured policy/control references
transition_table_mapping.delegation_model: responsible-party declarations do not independently establish current delegation
transition_table_mapping.decision_or_result_model: assessment findings and results are review evidence only
transition_table_mapping.receipt_or_trace_model: pinned model release, immutable source/sample identity, manifest, compatibility fixture, and validation reports
transition_table_mapping.reconstruction_model: source package, model version, document version, references, transformations, and assessment records support reconstruction when retained
transition_table_mapping.SPE_overlap: structured control/assessment evidence may inform review but not standing determination
transition_table_mapping.StegVerse_ecosystem_overlap: Policy Reference, Evidence Posture, Review Posture, Reconstructability, Drift, Fail-Closed behavior
transition_table_mapping.fail_closed_conditions: missing source identity, model/document version confusion, schema/reference failure, stale assessment, missing current authority, semantic scope divergence, or authority overclaim

SPE_overlap.standing_boundary: structured control and assessment evidence only
SPE_overlap.authority_evaluation: performed separately at the governed transition

StegVerse_ecosystem_overlap.documentation_surface: wiki reference plus manifest, fixtures, mappings, and generated reports

evidence_gap.next_local_transition: bind second page and six-family fixture to OSCAL 1.2.2 and validate merged state through the canonical workflow
evidence_gap.stronger_interoperability_evidence_trans: run and preserve a pinned OSCAL validator/converter against a frozen source package if a native tool-execution claim is later required

fail_closed_conditions: document version and OSCAL model version are conflated
document schema or references are unresolved
responsible party or delegation evidence is not current
requested action is outside represented scope
any certification, endorsement, standing, execution authority, or commit-time authority claim appears
